title: Entrys in the treatment menu only partially visible
symptom: In the treatment menu, entries are only partially visible and can therefore no longer be deleted (at least in portrait mode). Even when setting font size to small, the full line is not visible. In AndroidAPS 3.1.0 the issue is worse, and also affects the start screen where the amount of insulin remaining in the cartridge is not visible.
